name: 复制 Timing
description: 通过段落选择点击两个时间戳（不依赖区间内是否有音符），含首尾。仅处理当前时间组明确写出的 track/BPM，不复制或删除继承事件、chart 头或其他语句。按目标起点平移复制，保持间距和值，保留原段；不覆盖目标已有事件。整批一次撤销，仍需手动保存。
descriptionEn: Use Range Selection to pick two timestamps, including endpoints; notes are not required. Only explicit track/BPM in the current timinggroup are processed, excluding inherited events, chart headers and other statements. Copy to the target start with original spacing/values. Keep the source and existing target events. One Undo for the batch; Save manually.
